_comment: Copy this file per tender (e.g. tenders_root/UPKEEP/eligibility_rules.json), fill in estimated_cost_inr, and the rule engine computes PASS/FAIL + a plain-English conclusion per bidder automatically. No code changes needed for a new tender - only this file.

criteria.label: Declaration (Banned/suspended/blacklisted) submitted
criteria.fail_message: Declaration regarding banned/suspended/blacklisted status not submitted.

criteria.label: Technical Specification submitted
criteria.fail_message: Technical specification not submitted as per bid requirement.

criteria.label: Average Annual Turnover (last 3 financial years)
criteria.fail_message: The bidder failed to fulfill minimum required Average Turnover (must exceed 30% of tender value): hence Disqualified.
criteria.note: 30% here means the average annual turnover must EXCEED 30% of estimated_cost_inr. Change min_value_pct_of_estimate per tender, or set min_value_inr directly instead.

criteria.label: Turnover Certificate has valid UDIN
criteria.fail_message: Turnover Certificate submitted without a valid UDIN.

criteria.label: Past Experience of Similar Services
criteria.fail_message: The bidder failed to fulfill minimum required Experience: hence Disqualified.
criteria.note: PASS if the bidder has 3 contracts each >=30% of estimated cost, OR 2 contracts each >=50%, OR 1 contract >=80%. Edit the percentages per tender's actual NIT clause.
